question: Which product's model had the lowest coefficient of variation, and at what temperature and residence time was that product's maximum yield obtained?
expect: bio-gas, C.V. 1.99%; maximum 40.27% at 500 °C and 30 min (p3-4; Table 3)
rendered:
According to the document, the bio-gas yield model had the lowest coefficient of variation, with a value of 1.99. 

The maximum bio-gas yield of 40.27% was obtained at a pyrolysis temperature of 500°C and a residence time of 30 minutes.
